actions.sheets_get_values.props.workshee: The exact tab title to read from. Must match the tab name exactly (including spacing/case). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.descript: Insert blank rows or columns at a position, shifting existing data.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.di: Whether to insert rows or columns.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.en: The index just past the last inserted row/column (exclusive). The number inserted is (end - start): to insert 1 use start N, end N+1; to insert 3 at the top use start 0, end 3.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.in: When true, new rows/columns inherit formatting from the row/column before them; when false (default), from the one after.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.sh: The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.sp: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
actions.sheets_insert_dimension.props.st: Where to start inserting, 0-based and inclusive. Index 0 = before the first row/column (row 1 / column A). The range is half-open: [start, end).
actions.sheets_rename_worksheet.props.sh: The numeric worksheet (tab) id to rename. Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
actions.sheets_rename_worksheet.props.sp: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
actions.sheets_search_spreadsheets.props: If true, only return spreadsheets that exactly match the name. If false, return spreadsheets that contain the name.
The name of the spreadsheet to search for.
actions.sheets_update_dimension_properti: Set a fixed pixel size for rows/columns, or hide/unhide them.
Whether to act on columns (width) or rows (height).
The index just past the last column/row to update (exclusive). To update only column A use start 0, end 1.
Whether the rows/columns are hidden. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the current setting.
The fixed width (for columns) or height (for rows) in pixels. Leave empty to only change the hidden state.
The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
The first column/row to update, 0-based and inclusive. Column A / row 1 is index 0. The range is half-open: [start, end).
actions.sheets_update_multiple_rows.desc: Update several existing rows in one batch call.
actions.sheets_update_multiple_rows.prop: Inserted values that are dates and formulas will be entered as strings and have no effect.
The numeric worksheet (tab) id. Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
An array of row objects, each with a numeric "rowId" plus cells keyed by column letter, e.g. [{"rowId":2,"A":"x","B":"y"},{"rowId":5,"A":"z"}]. Rows without a rowId are skipped.
actions.sheets_update_row.description: Update the data in an existing row, identified by its row number.
actions.sheets_update_row.props.first_ro: When true, "values" is an object keyed by column letter, e.g. {"A":"x","B":"y"}. When false, "values" is a positional array, e.g. ["x","y"] mapped to columns A, B, … in order.
actions.sheets_update_row.props.sheet_id: The numeric worksheet (tab) id. Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
actions.sheets_update_row.props.spreadsh: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
actions.sheets_update_row.props.values.d: The row values. If "Values Keyed by Column Letter" is on, pass an object like {"A":"x","B":"y"}; otherwise pass an array like ["x","y"]. Empty strings skip (do not clear) the cell.
actions.sheets_update_sheet_properties.d: Update a worksheet's frozen rows/columns, tab color, or hidden state.
actions.sheets_update_sheet_properties.p: Number of columns to freeze at the left. Set 0 to unfreeze.
Number of rows to freeze at the top (e.g. 1 to freeze a header row). Set 0 to unfreeze.
Whether the worksheet tab is hidden. Leave empty or pick Leave unchanged to keep the current setting.
The numeric worksheet (tab) id (gid). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet. The first tab is usually 0.
The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
HEX color code for the tab, e.g. #FF0000.
actions.sheets_update_values.description: Write a 2D array of values into a worksheet at a specific A1 range.
actions.sheets_update_values.props.major: Whether each inner array of Values is a row (ROWS, default) or a column (COLUMNS).
actions.sheets_update_values.props.range: The cell range to write to, e.g. A1:D10. The shape of the values array must match this range (a 1x1 range cannot accept a 2x2 array).
actions.sheets_update_values.props.sprea: The ID of the spreadsheet (the Drive file id). Resolve from a name with sheets_search_spreadsheets.
actions.sheets_update_values.props.value: USER_ENTERED parses values like the Sheets UI (formulas, dates, numbers). RAW stores them verbatim as strings.
A 2D array of values, e.g. [["Name","Age"],["Alice",30]]. Each inner array is one row (when major dimension is ROWS) or one column (when COLUMNS).
actions.sheets_update_values.props.works: The exact tab title to write to. Must match the tab name exactly (including spacing/case). Resolve via sheets_get_spreadsheet or sheets_find_worksheet.
actions.update-multiple-rows.description: Updates multiple rows in a specific spreadsheet.
actions.update-multiple-rows.props.as_st: Store dates and formulas as plain text instead of evaluating them.
actions.update-multiple-rows.props.empty: Empty fields keep their current value.
actions.update-multiple-rows.props.heade: The row that contains the column names.
actions.update-multiple-rows.props.inclu: Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.
actions.update_row.description: Update the data in an existing row.
actions.update_row.props.empty_fields_in: Empty fields keep their current value.
actions.update_row.props.first_row_heade: Enter values by column name instead of left to right.
actions.update_row.props.includeTeamDriv: Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.
description: Create, edit, and collaborate on spreadsheets online
triggers.google-sheets-new-or-updated-ro: Triggers when a new row is added or modified in a spreadsheet.
Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.

Please note that there might be a delay of up to 3 minutes for the trigger to be fired, due to a delay from Google.

Rows that only move (insert, delete, sort) and format-only changes do not fire. With a Trigger Column, a new row fires once that column is filled.
Fire only when this column changes. Any Column fires on any cell.
triggers.googlesheets_new_row_added.desc: Triggers when a new row is added to the bottom of a worksheet.
triggers.googlesheets_new_row_added.prop: Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.

Please note that there might be a delay of up to 3 minutes for the trigger to be fired, due to a delay from Google.

Only rows added below the last row fire. Rows inserted higher up, sorting and edits do not.
triggers.new-spreadsheet.description: Triggers when a new spreadsheet is created.
triggers.new-spreadsheet.props.includeTe: Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.
triggers.new-worksheet.description: Triggers when a worksheet is created in a spreadsheet.
triggers.new-worksheet.props.includeTeam: Also include spreadsheets stored in shared drives.
triggers.new-worksheet.props.spreadsheet: The spreadsheet to watch for new worksheets.
